about: A held call's arguments as every app writes them under Details (KIFF's `arguments`, kept while the call is held): one line an argument; the gateway's own (kiff_operation_id, kiff_reason, kiff_about) and an empty string at the top left out; a list's items (1, 2, ...) below its name in the order sent, an object's fields below its name, two spaces deeper each level; keys sorted by Unicode code point at every level, the top and every nested object alike (a dictionary can't keep the order sent); an empty string below the top written as "" so a fill with nothing still shows; a number written out exactly as sent, an integer past 2^53 included (parse numbers without loss), and a decimal plainly with no trailing zero after the point (1.50 is 1.5, 2.0 is 2, 1.5e-05 is 0.000015), since not every app's JSON reader keeps them; a newline or any other control character in a key or value becomes one space, so a value can't draw a line of its own, and a direction mark (U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069, U+200E, U+200F, U+061C) is dropped; nothing ever shortened to "..." (red-team, 27 Nov: a held browse_act showed `steps: ...`). Written by hand, as data; every app's test reads every case and must produce `lines` exactly.

arguments.kiff_reason: Owner asked to fill customer name Test

cases.name: a list of plain values, and an object inside a list inside an object
nested keys sent out of order, a newline in a value, an empty fill and an integer past 2^53
lines: value: Ana   2:     kind: click     text: Pay

cases.name: decimals written plainly, without trailing zeros
